blocks.text: MANILA — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan is calling for an investigation into nearly P700 million worth of suspected smuggled rice seized at the ports of Davao and Limay, Bataan, citing the apparent lack of prosecutions against major smugglers despite a law imposing stiffer penalties for agricultural economic sabotage. “Gusto natin malaman ang puno’t dulo nito (We want to get to the bottom of this),” Pangilinan said in a statement Tuesday, adding that the investigation would most likely begin in the first week of November.
